_comment: What the AI colonies and the aliens say over the radio. One speaker per AI persona (server/ai/personas.js) plus the aliens. voice: a Kokoro voice (am_/af_ American, bm_/bf_ British, m male, f female), speed: 1 = normal. Each event has a few variants. Events of the colonies: war (first battle against you), attack (later battles at your planets), defeat (it loses a battle or a planet to you), victory (it beats you or takes your planet), ally (alliance with you), betray (it gives notice on your alliance). Short calls in any battle with you: engage, win, lose (aliens: engage, lose). The aliens speak no human language - 'text' is what the subtitle shows.  'templates': sentences with names, spoken on demand by the speech service (tts/) - {name} the speaker's colony, {player} the listener, {planet} the planet it is about, {ship} a named ship (destroyer) of the speaker there. A template is only used when all its names are known. Every line is spoken by the speech service (tts/) and cached (server/radio/tts.js); the server prepares all fixed lines in the background at start. To hear new lines before they go live: python tools/radio/preview.py (see there). 'crew': the player's own fleets answering orders - several voices ('voices'), every fleet keeps one; events: select, selectColony (a fleet with colonists), move, attack, colonize, chase (intercept a fleet), hole (into a wormhole). 'yard': the shipyard of an own planet answering when the planet is picked - two voices, every planet keeps one; its templates name the planet ({planet}), its lines are the fallback without names.

war: Your borders end where my fleet begins.
You have been weighed. And found wanting.
I gave you a chance to kneel. You wasted it.
defeat: Fall back. This is not over.
A setback. Nothing more.
Enjoy your little victory. It will be your last.
victory: As expected. Your defenses were a formality.
Raise my flag. Another world for the colony.
ally: An alliance, then. Do not make me regret it.
Together we crush the rest.
Very well. For now.
betray: Our alliance is over. Consider this your notice.
I have outgrown our little pact. Prepare yourself.
Friendship is a luxury.

war: We came here to build, not to fight. But you leave us no choice.
We are peaceful. Until attacked.
You have made a terrible mistake, neighbor. We do not forget.
attack: You started this. We are only finishing it.
For every planet you burned, we take one back.
Our patience is gone. All ships, advance.
defeat: We will rebuild. We always rebuild.
You may win this orbit. You will never win our people.
Fall back. Protect the settlers first.
victory: This world will bloom again, under our care.
We warned you. Now we plant our flag.
The colonists are landing. Your time here is over.
ally: Welcome, friend. There is room enough for all of us.
Together we can grow. Let us build something that lasts.
An alliance it is. Our harbors are open to you.
betray: I'm sorry. Our people come first.
We grew apart, you and I. Our alliance ends.
Forgive me. The council has decided against you.
